scenes.text: Class is in session. You put one thousand dollars on a credit card.
The average card that charges interest: twenty-two percent a year. That's the Fed's number.
You pay twenty-five dollars a month. Sounds responsible.
It takes seventy-three months. Six years.
You pay back one thousand eight hundred thirty-three dollars.
Eight hundred thirty-three dollars... just for waiting. Pay more than the minimum.

title: $1,000 on a Credit Card Costs You $833 Extra
